poses.name: Jodan
poses.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one transparent player battle sprite for an Edo samurai RPG. Image 1 is the APPROVED PLAYER: strictly preserve his identity, rear three-quarter viewing angle, indigo blue kimono, charcoal hakama, red-brown sash tied at back, cream collar, black topknot, straw sandals, dark scabbard, proportions, pixel cluster detail and upper-left lighting. Image 2 is only a POSE reference showing the opposing samurai; DO NOT COPY his brown clothing or front-facing view. Show the PLAYER FROM BEHIND, back and left shoulder toward the camera, looking diagonally UPPER RIGHT, a small right cheek profile visible. This sprite will stand in the lower-left of the battle facing an opponent upper-right. Keep his head/body scale and clothing exactly like image 1. Genuine transparent square background. Full body and entire katana visible with room around all edges. One character, one drawn katana, two hands on the same grip, no extra limbs, no text, no labels, no background, no shadow, no grid, no blur or painterly smoothing. Detailed CRISP PIXEL ART matching image 1. Requested pose: Jodan high guard: both hands together ABOVE the forehead, elbows raised, katana blade rises diagonally backward toward the UPPER LEFT, ready for a downward cut toward the opponent upper-right. Keep the back facing camera and head looking upper-right. Blade fully inside image. No swinging or motion trails.
